verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch is an API development and testing client: it sends requests, manages collections, and runs CLI tests. Enforcing rate limits on API traffic per consumer or route is an API-gateway or proxy function, which is outside this product category. Nothing in the evidence shows Hoppscotch sitting in the traffic path or shipping gateway rate-limiting.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can enforce rate limits on API traffic per consumer or route
